pattern_review.P35_P36: Complete F ownership denominator and original criterion spans are enumerated and verified against source commits/blobs.

LA-017 adjacent knowledge search changes are separately identified and do not imply a NormImpact-owner change.
pattern_review.P40: Candidate revalidation is one class widened to owner/bridge/consumer partitions and shared CAS/dispatch for applicable chains; B214/B56 are distinct bounded missing-input cases, not 35 repairs.
pattern_review.P41: F historical PASS/closed is never relabelled as b2 evidence; no target green/red without replay.
pattern_review.P05_P14: Protected authority/currentness/scientific validity remain explicit limitations; source-author reports and source diffs do not become independent authority.
